user.title: MyEnergy
user.description: Compare electricity and gas offers in Wallonia with the official CWaPE comparator. Consumption and your prices are on your annual statement.

data.current_product: Your current product name (optional, e.g. EASY)
data.day_electricity_consumption: Yearly consumption day / peak hours (kWh) — single-rate meter: all consumption
data.night_electricity_consumption: Yearly consumption night / off-peak hours (kWh) — 0 for a single-rate meter
data.own_price_day: Your contract: price day / peak hours (EUR/kWh excl. VAT, as on the annual statement; 0 = unknown)
data.own_price_night: Your contract: price night / off-peak hours (EUR/kWh excl. VAT)
data.own_price_excl_night: Your contract: price exclusive night (EUR/kWh excl. VAT)
data.own_fixed_fee: Your contract: fixed fee (EUR/year excl. VAT)
data.own_green_cost: Your contract: green energy cost (EUR/kWh excl. VAT)
data.gas_consumption: Yearly gas consumption (kWh) — 0 if no gas
